items.reason: A gentle-strength retinol is a sensible first step for softening the look of fine lines.
Retinol makes skin more sun-sensitive, so a daily mineral SPF 50 is needed alongside it.
A light ceramide moisturizer helps support comfort and the look of hydration, since the scan shows low moisture appearance.

response.routine_note: Start the retinol just 2 nights a week after cleansing, then add nights slowly as your skin feels comfortable, and layer the moisturizer over it. Apply the SPF every morning and reapply when outdoors.
